points.quote: `base/` holds general utilities and UI building blocks, such as events, lifecycle, strings, and DOM widgets.
`platform/` provides dependency-injection support and the base services shared across layers
`workbench/` is the full VS Code application: the workbench framework, `api/`, `services/`, and `contrib/` feature contributions.
`code/` is the desktop, CLI and web startup code (Electron main, shared process).
Layers, bottom to top ... Imports go downward only.
